**Cluster expansion for abstract polymer models. New bounds from an old approach**

*Roberto Fernández1 and Aldo Procacci1,2*

16 pp, 3 sections.

**Abstract.** polymer models. New bounds from an old approach Roberto Fern´andez1 and Aldo Procacci1,2 1Labo. de Maths Raphael SALEM, UMR 6085 CNRS-Univ. de Rouen, Avenue de l’Universit´e, BP.12, 76801 Saint Etienne du Rouvray, France 2 Dep. Matem´atica-ICEx, Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais, CP 702, Belo Horizonte MG 30.161-970, Brazil email: 1Roberto.Fernandez@univ-rouen.fr; 2aldo@mat.ufmg.br We revisit the classical approach to cluster expansions, based on tree graphs, and estab- lish a new convergence condition that improves those by Koteck´y-Preiss and Dobrushin, as we show in some examples. The two ingredients of our approach are: (i) a careful consideration of the Penrose identity for truncated functions, and (ii) the use of iterated transformations to bound tree-graph expansions.
